description: Blind at Scale D-SCALE 100M leg: zipf seed 101, fact 100M / fact2 60M, 9 pipelines, T=2,000,000 (= 0.02 x 100M). ALSO exports counts.npz (gen task), a deterministic 1% sample (hash(s) % 100 == 0, pipeline task --sample-out), and the exact per-key COUNT(DISTINCT s) for kA (--distinct-out) to the volume for the LOCAL arms run on the VM (predictions do not exist yet at 100M; no comparison against predictions from a different scale). The distinct_A export is REQUIRED: arms.run_arms indexes counts['distinct_A'] (D_A GT only) and would KeyError without it — the execution phase merges it into counts.npz before the local arms run (see README_JOB_DEFS.md). Driver-memory note: the 100M numpy generation holds ~100M-row int32 columns driver-side; if the gen task OOMs, that is a recorded finding, not a cue to shrink the dataset silently. max_retries 0: a retry would double-bill and muddy provenance.
